whats.TermSheet Capital Reports Rising Global: Demand for Indian AI firms is rising worldwide, so AI skills and services built in India may become more valuable to your business.
whats.Three stocks with strong order books to: Data centres are growing fast in India, and the companies that supply them are drawing attention. AI needs this physical base.

term.def: A large building full of powerful computers that store data and run AI tools. When you use an AI chatbot, your request is usually handled in one.

prompt.prompt: Act as a strategy advisor. Our company is [company and industry]. List five processes we could redesign with AI, not just speed up. For each, give the current step, the new way, and one risk.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds very confident, its answer is almost certainly correct.
quiz.why: AI can write wrong answers in a confident tone. Always check important facts, numbers and names before you use them.

quiz.q: SMEStreet reports that TermSheet Capital sees rising global demand for Indian AI firms.
quiz.why: This is what the SMEStreet headline says. It points to growing interest in AI companies built in India.

quiz.q: TradingView reports that AI is forcing recruitment firms to overhaul their business models.
quiz.why: This restates the TradingView headline. It shows AI is changing how whole businesses work, not only single tasks.

quiz.q: You need to know coding to get useful results from everyday AI tools.
quiz.why: Most AI tools work with plain language. You type what you need in normal words, like briefing a colleague.

quiz.q: Giving an AI tool clear context in your prompt usually leads to a better answer.
quiz.why: Details like your role, your audience and the format you want help the tool understand the task and respond better.
